messages.subject: RE: how to add another scale to the y axis in ggplot2
parts:
Use the breaks and labels arguments of scale_y_continuous() to set the label that you like on the appropriate position. E.g. scale_y_continuous(breaks  = 0:3, labels = c(1, 10, 100, 1000)))
